errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly transcribes the label for the red slice as '半模型式' (semi-model style), whereas the actual label in the legend is '半模板式' (semi-template style).
The description claims no slice is visually emphasized, but the red slice representing '半模板式' is clearly exploded (offset) from the rest of the pie, which is a common method of emphasis.
